record_purpose: Per-trial ingestion record for P1. One record per matched control/candidate pair. Maps one-to-one onto ruthless_pipeline.certification.physical.PhysicalTrial for the paired_trial_statistics path; the completed set is bound into the session ExperimentArtifact as the physical_session stage.
session_id: FILL-IN: must match the session manifest

trials.condition_id: FILL-IN: grid cell id, e.g. d0300_ym45_pp00_L1_standing

detector_outputs.model: FILL-IN: model id from the locked model manifest

conservative_trial_decision.rule: control_detected = ALL models detect the control AND control_score >= min_baseline_score; candidate_detected = ANY model detects the candidate (computed only on baseline-qualified captures), matching scripts/evaluate_physical_trial.py

validity.control_undetected_rule: A trial where the control garment is not detected is an INVALID measurement condition, never candidate success (split_valid_invalid in trial_statistics.py).
